notes:
Short summary: Auric evaluated Redwood for a catalog search + support assistant use case. Strong fit technically; liked runtime features (cache, rollouts). Primary sticking points: key ownership, VPC-only requirement, and unit economics vs internal infra. POC showed functional parity but cost delta favored self-host. Infra team prototype used vLLM + TGI on H100 with TensorRT-LLM quantized models and reported 40-60% lower inference spend in our synthetic calc.
